name: Triforce (Ocarina of Time, Switch 2)
by: The Triforce project (triforceproject.com), on NotRexed's Hookshot and NX2navi
about: The Switch 2 edition of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as a native PC game, recompiled from your own copy, with no emulator in between. Cartridge builds it from your copy in the background the first time (10 to 45 minutes, about 60 GB free while it builds), then starts it straight away. Needs Vulkan 1.3 with mesh shaders and 16 GB of memory.

game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
